native_mechanisms: Each byte/mark is folded into an impure (non-pure, memory-bearing) accumulator whose changed state becomes the seed for the next fold, so the whole buffer passes as one unbroken chained pour, each byte consumed exactly once.

The accumulator's final state is pushed through exactly seven fixed finalization stages in turn, each stage bending (multiplying) or discarding half of its input (shift-xor) and keeping only the moving bits.
A single input bit is flipped anywhere in the buffer and the whole pipeline is re-run from the start; any resemblance between the new and old digest condemns the whole method.
core_technique: Chained CRC accumulation over 8-byte words (hardware CRC32C/CRC32D intrinsic, else a table-driven reflected CRC-64/XZ) with non-zero init constants and 2-3 interleaved lanes, length mixed in, finished by a fixed 7-stage xor-rotate/multiply/xor-shift avalanche finalizer (nasam head + rrmxmx tail).
